title: Deprecation-safe routing and compatibility gates for pinned model versions
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers can pin to exact model builds for stability, but pinned versions create operational tension when a region loses capacity, a variant is deprecated, or new model fixes are required. We need a reproducible, reviewable policy and runtime behavior that preserves customer expectations (predictable outputs when they opt-in) while enabling graceful routing to keep services available and within latency/SLAs.

Goal: Define a single cross-team fallback contract and compatibility gate model for pinned versions that: (1) describes permitted runtime fallback behaviors, (2) defines deprecation windows and customer-visible notifications, (3) specifies telemetry thresholds and automated routing actions, and (4) lists required infra, Console, and audit changes to support the contract.

Scope: Hosted and Dedicated modes (Private to be covered next sprint), region-aware routing, model-variant fallbacks, canary rollouts for deprecation, and explicit customer opt-in flags (strict_pin).

Non-goals: Changing pinned semantics to a best-effort heuristic without explicit opt-in; autoscaling policy tuning (only integration points documented here).
notes: Introduced concept: fallback contract = observable, auditable rule-set attached to a pinned version describing allowed substitutions and escalation behavior.
Compatibility gates will be implemented as model metadata tags: compatibility_level (semantic string), tokenizer_hash, output_schema_version.
Strict_pin boolean flag for customers who require absolute no-fallback guarantees; strict_pin customers will receive higher error rates under constrained capacity rather than implicit substitutions.
Deprecation lifecycle: NOTICE -> WARN -> AUTO-FALLBACK -> RETIRE. Default grace = 90 days; can be shortened for security-critical fixes.
Telemetry triggers: sustained regional queue depth > 75% of target capacity for 3m or median p95 latency > 2x SLO for 2m should initiate progressive fallback steps.
Must add audit log events for every automatic fallback decision (model chosen, reason, pre/post token counts, request id).
